audio.t: Have you signed up for the language exchange program yet?

questions.explain: 問是否已報名語言交換，B 回答「已在週一上網報名」最合理。A 重複 exchange 但指退換商品；C 用 sign 與 signed 字形相近混淆。
options: I'd like to exchange this shirt for a smaller size.
Yes, I registered on the website on Monday.
It's on the sign by the door.

audio.t: Who's going to pick up the international students at the airport on Saturday?

questions.explain: 問「誰」去機場接人，A 說明學伴協調人安排了接駁車，回應了接送安排。B 用 picked 與 pick up 混淆；C 回答時間，不是人。
options: The buddy coordinator arranged a shuttle bus.

audio.t: Why don't we meet at the café near the language center after class?

questions.explain: Why don't we…? 是提議而非詢問原因，C「好啊，我四點後有空」接受提議。A 誤把它當成問原因而用 Because 作答；B 重複 center 但答非所問。

audio.t: Hi Kevin, how's it going with your language partner from Japan?
Pretty well. We meet twice a week, but she keeps switching to English, so I'm not getting much Japanese practice.
Maybe you two could split each meeting in half, thirty minutes in each language.
That's a good idea. I'll suggest it on Thursday.

questions.explain: 男子說對方一直切換成英文，所以「練不到日文」，對應 D。他們每週見兩次面，沒有取消或找不到地點的問題；Thursday 只是他打算提出建議的日子。
options: His partner often cancels their meetings.
They can't find a place to meet.
His partner is too busy on Thursdays.
He rarely gets to practice Japanese.
questions.prompt: What problem does the man mention?

audio.t: Excuse me, I'd like to join the international buddy program. Is it too late?
The first round closed last week, but we're opening a second round for students arriving in February. The deadline is December fifth.
Great. Do I need anything besides the online form?
Just a short self-introduction video, about one minute long.

questions.explain: 女子說除了線上表單，只需要「約一分鐘的自我介紹影片」，選 C。成績單與推薦信對話中都沒有提到。
questions.prompt: What must the man submit in addition to the online form?

audio.t: Attention, all buddy program volunteers. Tonight's welcome dinner for new international students has been moved from the student cafeteria to the second-floor lounge of the International House, because the cafeteria is being repaired. The dinner will still begin at six thirty. Please arrive fifteen minutes early to help set up the tables and name tags. Thank you.

questions.explain: 晚宴六點半開始，志工要「提早十五分鐘」到場幫忙布置，所以是六點十五分，選 B。C 是晚宴開始時間，不是志工到場時間。

audio.t: Good afternoon, everyone, and thank you for volunteering as international buddies this year. I'm Lisa from the Office of International Affairs. Each of you will be matched with one or two exchange students who arrive in February. Your main job during their first two weeks is practical: help them open a bank account, get a local phone number, and register for health insurance at the student health center. Many students also feel lost using the online course system, which is mostly in Chinese, so please walk them through it.

After the first month, things become more relaxed. We ask you to meet your buddy at least twice a month, but where you go is up to you. Night markets and hiking trips are always popular. Please remember that you are not a tour guide, and you are not a translator for their homework. If your buddy seems homesick or stressed for more than a few weeks, contact our office rather than trying to solve it yourself. Finally, volunteers who complete the semester will receive eighteen hours of service-learning credit.

questions.explain: 講者自我介紹「來自國際事務處（Office of International Affairs）」，選 C。健康中心只是她提到要協助學生辦保險的地點。
options: A nurse at the student health center
A staff member of the international office

questions.explain: 講者明確說若學伴想家或壓力大持續數週，要「聯絡我們辦公室，而不是自己解決」，選 A。健行是平常活動的例子；她也說學伴不是作業翻譯。
options: Take the buddy on a hiking trip
questions.prompt: What should buddies do if their buddy seems stressed for a long time?

questions.explain: 前兩週的任務包括開銀行帳戶、辦手機門號、辦保險，以及帶他們使用多為中文的線上課程系統，故選 B、E。講者強調不需翻譯作業；夜市是第一個月後的自由活動，訂機票未提及。
questions.prompt: Which TWO tasks are buddies expected to help with during the first two weeks? (Choose TWO.)

questions.explain: are asked to 後接原形動詞，familiarize oneself with 表示「使自己熟悉」，選 C。familiar 是形容詞、familiarity 是名詞、familiarly 是副詞，都不能接在 to 後當動詞。
questions.prompt: Before the first exchange session, participants are asked to ______ themselves with a few basic greetings in their partner's language.

questions.explain: 兩人都很忙，所以選擇線上見面「而不是」面對面，instead of 最合理。as well as 表示「兩者都」，與忙碌的前提矛盾；in spite of、because of 語意不通。
questions.prompt: Because both partners had busy schedules, they decided to meet online ______ in person.

head: From: Office of International Affairs
To: Spring 2027 Buddy Program Applicants
Subject: Matching results and next steps
passage: Thank you for applying to the Spring 2027 International Buddy Program. We received 142 applications for 95 incoming exchange students, so some of you have been placed on a waiting list. Please check your matching result on the student portal by Friday, November 27.

If you have been matched, you must attend one training session before the end of the semester. Sessions will be held on December 3 and December 10 from 6:00 to 8:00 p.m. in Room 205 of the International House. Please register for your preferred date through the portal. Students who cannot attend either session should email us so that we can arrange an online alternative.

Matched volunteers will receive their buddy's contact information in early January. We encourage you to send a short welcome message before your buddy leaves for Taiwan, as early contact helps new students feel less anxious about their arrival.

Best regards,
Office of International Affairs

questions.explain: 信中說收到 142 份申請，但只有 95 位交換生，因此部分人列入候補，選 D。截止日、訓練課程與語言成績都不是候補的原因。
options: They did not attend a training session.
Their language test scores were too low.
There were more applicants than incoming students.
questions.prompt: Why have some applicants been placed on a waiting list?

questions.explain: 第二段寫明兩場都無法參加的學生「應寄信給我們」，以安排線上替代方案，選 B。一月是收到學伴聯絡資料的時間，不是訓練時間。
questions.prompt: What should a matched volunteer do if neither training date works?

questions.explain: anxious 意為「焦慮的、擔心的」，及早聯絡能讓新生對抵達「比較不擔心」，最接近 worried。excited 是興奮，curious 是好奇，confused 是困惑。
questions.prompt: The word "anxious" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to

reading.title: Matching Results and Next Steps

passage: When third-year engineering student Tsai Yu-ting joined her university's language exchange program last spring, she expected to improve her Spanish quickly. Instead, after three meetings with her partner from Madrid, she noticed they were speaking almost entirely in English. "It was comfortable for both of us," she admitted, "but I wasn't learning anything."

Tsai's experience is common, according to Dr. Helen Brooks, who coordinates the program at the university's Language Center. "Language exchange is one of the cheapest and most enjoyable ways to practice speaking," she explained, "but without some structure, the stronger language usually takes over." This year, the center has introduced simple guidelines. Partners are asked to divide each meeting equally between the two languages and to agree on a topic in advance, such as food, travel, or a recent film. They are also given a short checklist to record new expressions they learn.

The early results look promising. In a survey of 120 participants at the end of the midterm period, 78 percent said the guidelines helped them use their target language more often. Several international students added that the program helped them make local friends, something they had found difficult in classes taught mainly in Chinese.

Still, Brooks warns that language exchange is not a replacement for formal study. "Your partner is a friend, not a teacher," she said. "They can tell you what sounds natural, but they may not be able to explain grammar rules." She recommends that students combine exchange sessions with regular courses or tutoring at the Writing Center.
As for Tsai, she now meets her partner every Wednesday at a café near campus. "We still laugh a lot," she said, "but now I actually leave each meeting with ten new Spanish words."

questions.explain: 第一段說見面三次後她發現兩人「幾乎全程講英文」，所以學不到西班牙文，選 A。文中沒有提到缺席、口音或課程不提供西班牙文。
options: She and her partner mostly spoke English.
Her partner often missed their meetings.
She could not understand her partner's accent.
The program did not offer Spanish.
questions.prompt: What was Tsai's problem at first?

questions.explain: Brooks 說沒有架構時「較強的語言通常會主導（takes over）」，D 的 dominates 為同義改寫。其他選項文中都沒有提到。
options: Partners stop meeting after a few weeks.
questions.prompt: According to Dr. Brooks, what usually happens when language exchange has no structure?

questions.explain: 第四段她建議把交換時段與正式課程或寫作中心輔導「結合」，選 B。她明確說語言交換不能取代正式學習，也說夥伴是朋友不是老師，故 A、C 錯。
options: Replacing regular courses with exchange sessions
Combining exchange sessions with formal study
Choosing partners who are trained teachers

questions.explain: 第二段列出的規則是「每次時間平分給兩種語言」與「事先約定主題」，選 A、C。文中的清單是給自己記錄新詞，不是交報告；見面地點與文法測驗都未規定。
options: Dividing each meeting evenly between the two languages
Meeting only inside the Language Center
Choosing a topic before each meeting
Taking a grammar test every month
Writing a report for the coordinator
questions.prompt: Which TWO guidelines has the Language Center introduced? (Choose TWO.)

reading.title: Talk Partners: Why Language Exchange Works, and When It Doesn't

words.ex: The buddy coordinator arranged a shuttle bus for the new students.
Please familiarize yourself with the campus map before orientation.
Many exchange students feel homesick during their first winter abroad.
Because the program was full, Amy was placed on the waiting list.
The office offers an online alternative for students who cannot attend.
The new guidelines ask partners to split each meeting evenly.
Try to use your target language for at least half of each session.
